description: This file declares the TpmGatekeeper class, which extends the gatekeeper::GateKeeper interface. It provides methods for managing authentication tokens, passwords, signatures, randomness, failure records, and hardware backing status, specifically utilizing TPM (Trusted Platform Module) resources. The class interacts with a TpmResourceManager and secure/insecure storage to perform its functions.

classes.name: TpmGatekeeper
classes.description: A class that manages TPM-based gatekeeper functionalities, including key management, signature computation, failure record handling, and hardware-backed status, utilizing TPM resource management and storage.

methods.name: TpmGatekeeper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TpmGatekeeper with TPM resource manager and secure/insecure storage references.

methods.name: GetAuthTokenKey
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication token key and its length.

methods.name: ComputePasswordSignature
methods.description: Computes a signature for the password using the provided key and salt.

methods.name: GetRandom
methods.description: Generates random bytes of the requested size.

methods.name: ComputeSignature
methods.description: Computes a cryptographic signature over a message with a given key.

methods.name: GetMillisecondsSinceBoot
methods.description: Returns milliseconds elapsed since system boot.

methods.name: GetFailureRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the failure record for a user identified by uid and user_id.

methods.name: ClearFailureRecord
methods.description: Clears the failure record for a user.

methods.name: WriteFailureRecord
methods.description: Stores a failure record for a user.

methods.name: IsHardwareBacked
methods.description: Indicates whether the underlying key storage is hardware-backed.
